About Solomon

Personal attention.
A local place to learn.

Small-group support for students across West Dublin and North Kildare, with classes based in Lucan at Scoil Áine Naofa.

Learning alongside school

More time to
make it make sense.

Solomon Grinds offers subject support that complements school learning. Its published approach centres on small groups, individual attention and preparation for exams.

Caitriona Hayes is the booking contact and is identified as the owner and a Maths teacher in her public professional profile. Her profile dates the business to 2002; we use that date instead of repeating an unverified anniversary claim.

Sources: Business About page ↗ and Caitriona’s public professional profile ↗.

What we can say
with confidence.

The existing site describes experienced, hand-picked teaching staff, including past or present examiners. Individual teacher names and credentials are not provided there.

This concept does not add qualifications, pass rates, class-size numbers or grade promises. Ask Caitriona about the teacher and format for your chosen class.

Built around practical choices

  • Flexible attendanceAn advertised online platform for students who cannot attend in person. Confirm subject availability.
